scope: Independent artifact and FITS-metadata verification for the ten public MAST products in parent protocol.json/result.json
checks: exact ten filename/URI and local SHA256 closure to acquisition result and per-file JSON
FITS block/HDU layout and embedded CHECKSUM/DATASUM status if present
DRZ four-input closure against four acquired FLT roots per association
WCS and distortion/PAM reference-key inventory; availability versus historical equivalence
prohibitions: No pixel values, pixel statistics, image display, SN or sky flux, aperture/noise outcomes, or historical reduction equivalence claim
method: Use astropy.io.fits with lazy HDUs and no image-array reads for header inventory; full-file SHA256 streaming; FITS checksum verification may scan bytes only for integrity; preserve missing metadata as missing
historical_caveat: These are current public 2026 CALWF3/AstroDrizzle products, not demonstrated RAISIN-private reductions.
